lastCompletedStory.title: Fix cam binary HELP for next and plan

nextStoryContext: US-001 fixed only the top-level `cam --help` entries for `next` (line ~99, now 'Trigger the sidecar loop (flips active:true, thin-proxy)', matching README line 133 wording) and `plan` (line ~97, now `plan [<N>]` instead of `plan [--issue <N>]`, matching PLAN_HELP usage at index.ts:209). No behavior change, no argument parser change (plan.ts already only accepted a positional issue number; the old top-level entry text was just stale). US-002 (next story) targets version.ts comment + package.json parity assert -- unrelated surface, no shared state.
